# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 62 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 62

Jesus said: "I tell my mysteries to those who are worthy of my mysteries. Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing."

---

**Council Notes:**

- "Mysteries" (*mystērion*) preserved; PNEUMA's "hidden teachings" is an acceptable gloss but loses the technical term.
- "Tell" (EMET) preferred over "speak" (LOGOS) for the natural English idiom "tell mysteries."
- The right/left hand saying (cf. Matt 6:3) functions here in the context of esoteric transmission, not almsgiving. Thomas recontextualizes it.
- The two clauses may be independent sayings joined by a scribal editorial hand.
